entities.summary: Thomas Warner, a notable figure in the history of Saint Kitts and Nevis, associated with European Contact and the Mother Colony of the West Indies (1623–1650). Preceded by Thomas Warner founds first English Caribbean colony on Saint Kitts and Christopher. Their legacy influenced Pierre Belain d'Esnambuc founds first French Caribbean colony on Saint Kitts and Kalinago Massacre at Bloody Point.
